citation.authors: Sorrells L, Senak L, Kang X, Abegunde A et al

record.population: Textured hair tresses (laboratory, industry methods paper)
record.design: Adapted methods for shine, curl shrinkage, flexibility and 'consumer-perceived hair porosity' by contact angle
record.finding: The authors describe a refined contact-angle method to measure consumer-perceived hair porosity in textured hair. It is a method paper and tests no routine.
record.note: Industry-style methods paper; funding not checked.
